files.docs/timezones.md:
# Time zones

## Why UTC storage

Lisbon and Milan sites share recurring meetings across a one-hour offset.
Local times stored as-is shift by an hour on DST changes, so we store UTC
and keep the site zone only for display.

# roomshare-booking

Booking service for the RoomShare network of shared meeting rooms.
Members reserve rooms at any site of the network.

## Finding a room

`GET /availability?sites=lis,mil&startAt=...&endAt=...&minCapacity=6`
